subject.title: refactor: prune unsupported OPENCLAW env overrides

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally remove these seven undocumented environment fallbacks without a deprecation or doctor migration?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but repository policy treats removed config and fallback surfaces as an upgrade-sensitive product decision because unknown external scripts may rely on them.

options.title: Accept bounded deletion
options.body: Merge after rebasing because the removed names are undocumented, repository-unreferenced duplicates with supported canonical replacements or injected seams.

options.title: Add a transition path
options.body: Retain or diagnose the aliases temporarily and document a removal window if maintainers want to protect unknown external consumers.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded deletion
recommendation.body: Merge after rebasing because the removed names are undocumented, repository-unreferenced duplicates with supported canonical replacements or injected seams.
